description: Retrieve a Scopus institution profile by affiliation_id or eid. Returns the original Elsevier JSON, including profile data or one page of related documents/authors when requested through view. Access depends on entitlements; no linked records or additional pages are fetched automatically.

affiliation_id.description: One Scopus affiliation ID. Provide exactly one of affiliation_id or eid; comma-separated lists are not supported.

eid.description: One affiliation electronic ID (EID). Use instead of affiliation_id; comma-separated lists are not supported.

field.description: Comma-separated response fields to include; unavailable with DOCUMENTS and AUTHORS views.

refcount.description: Number of related documents or authors to return; API limits depend on service level.

reqId.description: Caller-supplied request identifier for Elsevier support.

startref.description: Zero-based result offset for related documents or authors. No additional pages are fetched automatically.

view.description: Response view (API default: LIGHT). DOCUMENTS and AUTHORS return related records. Availability depends on entitlements.

name: affiliation_retrieval

affiliation-name.description: Name of the affiliation in the Scopus profile.

author-count.description: Number of authors associated with the affiliation, preserved as the API string.

dc:identifier.description: Scopus affiliation identifier, usually prefixed with AFFILIATION_ID:.

document-count.description: Number of documents associated with the affiliation, preserved as the API string.

eid.description: Scopus electronic identifier (EID) for the affiliation.

prism:url.description: Elsevier API URL for this affiliation profile.

coredata.description: Core affiliation identifiers and counts; available fields depend on the requested view.
